prompts.humanwalk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG production HUMAN WALK CYCLE atlas.
Create 16 full-body military soldier sprites, exactly 4 columns x4 rows with very clear cell separation and ample transparent margins,1024x1024. Each about200pixels high, feet at same baseline. All entire guns and boots fitinside cells. Dark cinematic realistic hand-painted detailed art, orthographic30degree isometric angle,upper-left light. No words,grid,ground,shadows,scenery.
Rows4classes: row1 olive patrolman soft cap and pistol; row2 olive helmeted rifleman with vest and backpack; row3 bulky dark slate-armored guard with visor helmet and machinegun; row4 green hooded scout with longrifle and radio antenna.
CRITICAL: COLUMNS1and2 MUST SHOW OPPOSITE LEGS and arm positions, not same pose. COLUMNS3and4 MUST ALSO SHOW OPPOSITE LEGS. These are physically distinct run keyframes.
Col1 front-right view, LEFT THIGH lifted forward knee high, LEFT BOOT in front at left of screen, RIGHT LEG extends far backward with rightheel lifted; gun held angled down-left, shoulder twisted LEFT forward.
Col2 front-right view, RIGHT THIGH lifted forward knee high, RIGHT BOOT in front at right of screen, LEFT LEG extends far backward with leftheel lifted; gun held angled down-right, shoulder twisted RIGHT forward. Visually opposite column1, not a copied silhouette.
Col3 back-right view, LEFT BOOT far forward touching ground at upper-right, RIGHT LEG trailing far back with rightboot lifted lower-left, left shoulder forward. Back ofuniform visible.
Col4 back-right view, RIGHT BOOT far forward touching ground at upper-right, LEFT LEG trailing far back with leftboot lifted lower-left, right shoulder forward. Back ofuniform visible. Opposite limb phase col3.
Dynamic natural running posture with slight forwardlean and opposing shoulders. Strong separation between both legs. Matching character identity/proportions in row. These must be usable alternating limb cycles.
